*Integration delivers seamless multi-rail payment execution within Emburse’s unified spend platform*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 13, 2026--[Repay Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: RPAY) (“REPAY”)](https://repay.com/) , a leading provider of bill payment solutions, today announced its partnership with[Emburse](https://www.emburse.com/platform/emburse-pay) , a global leader in travel and expense management, and integration with its accounts payable (AP) solutions. The integration powers small-to-enterprise organizations across legal services, healthcare, financial services and other key verticals. Bringing together invoice processing, approval workflows and vendor payments in one intuitive platform gives finance teams greater visibility and control over every dollar spent.


Finance teams at scaling organizations face a common challenge: payment operations spread across multiple AP systems, payroll platforms, and banking portals, while regional providers create fragmented workflows that limit visibility and weaken financial control. REPAY's integrations with Emburse's Spend, Pro and Enterprise platforms close those gaps by building payment execution into the software finance teams already use.


Emburse customers can now pay domestic vendors by ACH, virtual card, digital disbursement or check, and finance teams no longer export payment files to banking portals or manage separate release steps.


Payment execution sits inside the approval workflow, so every outbound payment is reviewed and audit ready before funds are released. Replacing paper checks with digital payment methods strengthens security, and finance teams get complete visibility into payment status and execution.


“Finance teams are stuck stitching together disconnected payment processes—and it slows everything down,” said Darin Horrocks, Executive Vice President, Business Payments at REPAY. “We built our integration with Emburse to remove that friction. Payments happen where the work already happens, with the controls finance teams need and none of the manual overhead.”


“For too long, payments have lived outside the systems that actually regulate spend,” said Landon Gordon, Vice President, Product Management, Emburse. “That disconnect is where finance teams lose critical visibility and control. By embedding payment execution directly into Emburse’s software platform through our integrated partnership with REPAY, we’re closing that gap and turning payments into a fully governed part of the spend lifecycle.”


For AP and finance teams, that means less reliance on banking portals and manual funding steps. For employees, it means faster reimbursements without sacrificing oversight or compliance.


REPAY's payment processing capabilities are available to Emburse customers today. For more information, please visit:[www.emburse.com/platform/emburse-pay](https://www.emburse.com/platform/emburse-pay)


**About REPAY**


[REPAY](https://repay.com/) provides integrated bill payment solutions to verticals that have specific transaction processing needs. REPAY's proprietary, integrated payment technology provides a comprehensive end-to-end platform offering digital payments, bill design & presentment, and communication services for clients, while enhancing the overall experience for consumers and businesses.


**About Emburse**


Trusted globally by more than 12 million finance leaders, travel managers, and professionals, Emburse helps organisations control spend across complex finance operations, serving over 20,000 organizations in 200 countries and territories—including Global 2000 enterprises, SMBs, public sector agencies, and nonprofits.


By proactively managing and accurately validating spend, Emburse ensures robust financial governance, enhanced compliance, and unsurpassed visibility into spend behaviors—all while dramatically streamlining the process for every employee.


Emburse’s Expense Intelligence approach transforms reactive expense management into infrastructure for strategic growth. Powered by Emburse AI, it orchestrates corporate spend across travel booking, reimbursements, AP, and payments, embedding dynamic policy controls and predictive insights directly into workflows. This real-time approach empowers organisations to adapt quickly, reduce risk, and guide spend before money leaves the business.


To learn more about Emburse, visit[www.emburse.com](https://www.emburse.com/)
